clips.title: The story
paras: Drusilla La Salle sends the Tainted Letter to human warlock initiates near Northshire Abbey. It bears her seal and directs them to seek her tutelage discreetly.

The Tainted Letter bears Drusilla La Salle’s insignia and reaches initiates returning from nearby kobold camps. While priests, paladins, and soldiers train openly across Northshire Abbey’s lawns, fel practitioners must keep their path quiet. The letter directs novice warlocks to find their mentor near the abbey grounds without drawing the notice of town guards or clerics.

Drusilla La Salle meets her pupils on the fringes, where sentries are less likely to pry. Elwynn’s ordinary folk distrust warlocks, so the letter begins a lesson in discipline. Arcane and nether magic bring the risk of corruption. Those who commune with denizens of the Twisting Nether must temper ambition with patient self-control.
